instruction: Use a Fusion 360 API script or command-line automation workflow for Fusion-compatible CAM generation. Read the initial file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\cli_plate.step, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\tools.csv. Using the CLI workflow, create a 3-axis milling setup for C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\cli_plate.step. Face the top surface with T1, a 12 mm face mill. Put the WCS origin at the stock top-face center and use S6000 rpm and F750 mm/min. Export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-21.nc and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-21_setup.html. Tool definition: T1 is a 12 mm face mill, S6000 rpm, F750 mm/min. Write the output file(s) to the Desktop path(s) using exactly these absolute file paths: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-21.nc, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-21_setup.html.
